package verificationfixture

import (
	"bytes"
	"context"
	"embed"
	"encoding/json"
	"errors"
	"fmt"
	"reflect"
	"regexp"
	"strings"
	"time"

	"github.com/example/mc-course-service/internal/domain"
	"github.com/example/mc-course-service/internal/domain/repository"
	"github.com/example/mc-course-service/internal/usecase/contentaccess"
	"github.com/example/mc-course-service/internal/usecase/course"
	"github.com/example/mc-course-service/internal/usecase/lesson"
	moduleuc "github.com/example/mc-course-service/internal/usecase/module"
	sectionuc "github.com/example/mc-course-service/internal/usecase/section"
	"github.com/example/mc-course-service/internal/usecase/task"
	"github.com/google/uuid"
)

// ErrDrift identifies a canonical fixture or one of its shared reference rows
// that exists but no longer matches the versioned definition.
var ErrDrift = errors.New("verification fixture drift")

//go:embed fixture.v1.json
var fixtureFiles embed.FS

var slugPattern = regexp.MustCompile(`^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9-]{0,254}$`)

type Text struct {
	Title       string `json:"title"`
	Description string `json:"description"`
}

type LessonText struct {
	Title       string `json:"title"`
	Excerpt     string `json:"excerpt"`
	Description string `json:"description"`
}

type FixtureTask struct {
	Type                   string          `json:"type"`
	AssessmentPurpose      string          `json:"assessment_purpose"`
	CodeStructureType      string          `json:"code_structure_type"`
	CodeStructure          json.RawMessage `json:"code_structure"`
	ExecutionMode          string          `json:"execution_mode"`
	EvaluationMode         string          `json:"evaluation_mode"`
	UIMode                 string          `json:"ui_mode"`
	SubmissionMode         string          `json:"submission_mode"`
	RequiresSandbox        bool            `json:"requires_sandbox"`
	ExposesPreview         bool            `json:"exposes_preview"`
	ExposesTerminal        bool            `json:"exposes_terminal"`
	SupportsLiveValidation bool            `json:"supports_live_validation"`
	Translations           map[string]Text `json:"-"`
	EN                     Text            `json:"en"`
	RU                     Text            `json:"ru"`
}

type IDs struct {
	Course  string `json:"course"`
	Module  string `json:"module"`
	Section string `json:"section"`
	Lesson  string `json:"lesson"`
	Task    string `json:"task"`
}

// Definition is the source-owned, versioned content contract embedded in this
// package. It intentionally contains one public course and one guest lesson.
type Definition struct {
	FixtureID      string                `json:"fixture_id"`
	FixtureVersion int                   `json:"fixture_version"`
	Slug           string                `json:"slug"`
	IDs            IDs                   `json:"ids"`
	Languages      []string              `json:"languages"`
	Course         map[string]Text       `json:"course"`
	Module         map[string]Text       `json:"module"`
	Section        map[string]Text       `json:"section"`
	Lesson         map[string]LessonText `json:"lesson"`
	Task           FixtureTask           `json:"task"`
}

// LoadDefinition loads and validates the embedded canonical contract.
func LoadDefinition() (Definition, error) {
	data, err := fixtureFiles.ReadFile("fixture.v1.json")
	if err != nil {
		return Definition{}, err
	}
	var definition Definition
	if err := json.Unmarshal(data, &definition); err != nil {
		return Definition{}, err
	}
	definition.Task.Translations = map[string]Text{"en": definition.Task.EN, "ru": definition.Task.RU}
	if err := definition.Validate(); err != nil {
		return Definition{}, err
	}
	return definition, nil
}

func (d Definition) Validate() error {
	if strings.TrimSpace(d.FixtureID) == "" || d.FixtureVersion < 1 || !slugPattern.MatchString(d.Slug) {
		return errors.New("invalid verification fixture identity")
	}
	if len(d.Languages) != 2 || d.Languages[0] != "en" || d.Languages[1] != "ru" {
		return errors.New("verification fixture languages must be en, ru")
	}
	for name, translations := range map[string]map[string]Text{
		"course": d.Course, "module": d.Module, "section": d.Section, "task": d.Task.Translations,
	} {
		if len(translations) != len(d.Languages) {
			return fmt.Errorf("invalid %s translations", name)
		}
		for _, language := range d.Languages {
			text, ok := translations[language]
			if !ok || strings.TrimSpace(text.Title) == "" || strings.TrimSpace(text.Description) == "" {
				return fmt.Errorf("invalid %s translation for %s", name, language)
			}
		}
	}
	if len(d.Lesson) != len(d.Languages) {
		return errors.New("invalid lesson translations")
	}
	for _, language := range d.Languages {
		text, ok := d.Lesson[language]
		if !ok || strings.TrimSpace(text.Title) == "" || strings.TrimSpace(text.Excerpt) == "" || strings.TrimSpace(text.Description) == "" {
			return fmt.Errorf("invalid lesson translation for %s", language)
		}
	}
	for name, id := range map[string]string{
		"course": d.IDs.Course, "module": d.IDs.Module, "section": d.IDs.Section, "lesson": d.IDs.Lesson, "task": d.IDs.Task,
	} {
		if _, err := uuid.Parse(id); err != nil {
			return fmt.Errorf("invalid %s id: %w", name, err)
		}
	}
	seenIDs := map[string]struct{}{}
	for _, id := range []string{d.IDs.Course, d.IDs.Module, d.IDs.Section, d.IDs.Lesson, d.IDs.Task} {
		if _, exists := seenIDs[id]; exists {
			return errors.New("verification fixture entity ids must be unique")
		}
		seenIDs[id] = struct{}{}
	}
	taskType, err := domain.ParseTaskType(d.Task.Type)
	if err != nil || taskType != domain.TaskTypeQuizTheory {
		return errors.New("verification fixture requires quiz_theory task")
	}
	if d.Task.AssessmentPurpose != domain.AssessmentPurposeKnowledgeCheck || d.Task.CodeStructureType != "QUIZ_TEXT_BASIC" {
		return errors.New("verification fixture task reference is invalid")
	}
	if _, err := domain.ParseTaskExecutionMode(d.Task.ExecutionMode); err != nil {
		return fmt.Errorf("invalid task execution mode: %w", err)
	}
	if _, err := domain.ParseTaskEvaluationMode(d.Task.EvaluationMode); err != nil {
		return fmt.Errorf("invalid task evaluation mode: %w", err)
	}
	if _, err := domain.ParseTaskUIMode(d.Task.UIMode); err != nil {
		return fmt.Errorf("invalid task UI mode: %w", err)
	}
	if _, err := domain.ParseTaskSubmissionMode(d.Task.SubmissionMode); err != nil {
		return fmt.Errorf("invalid task submission mode: %w", err)
	}
	if d.Task.ExecutionMode != "NO_RUN" || d.Task.EvaluationMode != "AUTO" || d.Task.UIMode != "QUIZ" || d.Task.SubmissionMode != "ANSWER_PAYLOAD" || d.Task.RequiresSandbox || d.Task.ExposesPreview || d.Task.ExposesTerminal || d.Task.SupportsLiveValidation {
		return errors.New("verification fixture task must use the no-run quiz contract")
	}
	if len(bytes.TrimSpace(d.Task.CodeStructure)) == 0 || !json.Valid(d.Task.CodeStructure) {
		return errors.New("verification fixture task code structure is invalid")
	}
	return nil
}

// Dependencies are the Course-owned repositories needed to create and verify
// this exact fixture through the existing Course use cases.
type Dependencies struct {
	Tx               repository.TransactionManager
	Courses          repository.CourseRepository
	CourseI18n       repository.CourseI18nRepository
	CourseOutlines   repository.CourseOutlineRepository
	ContentAccess    repository.ContentAccessRepository
	CourseReadAccess repository.LessonReadAccessRepository
	I18n             repository.I18nRepository
	CodeStructures   repository.CodeStructureTypeRepository
	Modules          repository.ModuleRepository
	ModuleI18n       repository.ModuleI18nRepository
	CourseModules    repository.CourseModuleRepository
	Sections         repository.SectionRepository
	SectionI18n      repository.SectionI18nRepository
	ModuleSections   repository.ModuleSectionRepository
	Lessons          repository.LessonRepository
	LessonI18n       repository.LessonI18nRepository
	SectionLessons   repository.SectionLessonRepository
	Tasks            repository.TaskRepository
	TaskI18n         repository.TaskI18nRepository
}

type Provisioner struct {
	Dependencies Dependencies
	Definition   Definition
}

type Result struct {
	Status         string `json:"status"`
	FixtureID      string `json:"fixture_id"`
	FixtureVersion int    `json:"fixture_version"`
	CourseID       string `json:"course_id"`
	CourseSlug     string `json:"course_slug"`
	CourseActive   bool   `json:"course_active"`
	CatalogVisible bool   `json:"catalog_visible"`
	Modules        int    `json:"modules"`
	Sections       int    `json:"sections"`
	Lessons        int    `json:"lessons"`
	GuestReadable  bool   `json:"guest_readable"`
}

// Ensure creates the fixture atomically when absent, verifies it without
// writes when exact, and returns ErrDrift for any conflicting canonical state.
func (p Provisioner) Ensure(ctx context.Context) (Result, error) {
	if err := p.validateDependencies(); err != nil {
		return Result{}, err
	}
	if err := p.Definition.Validate(); err != nil {
		return Result{}, err
	}
	var result Result
	err := p.Dependencies.Tx.WithTx(ctx, func(txctx repository.Context) error {
		definition := p.Definition
		deps := p.Dependencies
		courseRecord, err := deps.Courses.GetBySlug(txctx, definition.Slug)
		created := false
		var languageIDs map[string]int
		var structure domain.CodeStructureType
		if err == nil {
			languageIDs, err = resolveLanguages(txctx, deps.I18n, definition.Languages, false)
			if err != nil {
				return err
			}
			structure, err = resolveQuizStructure(txctx, deps.CodeStructures, false)
			if err != nil {
				return err
			}
		} else if errors.Is(err, domain.ErrNotFound) {
			if err := p.ensureEntityIDsAvailable(txctx); err != nil {
				return err
			}
			languageIDs, err = resolveLanguages(txctx, deps.I18n, definition.Languages, true)
			if err != nil {
				return err
			}
			structure, err = resolveQuizStructure(txctx, deps.CodeStructures, true)
			if err != nil {
				return err
			}
			if err := p.createFixture(txctx, languageIDs, structure.ID); err != nil {
				return err
			}
			courseRecord, err = deps.Courses.GetBySlug(txctx, definition.Slug)
			if err != nil {
				return fmt.Errorf("read created verification course: %w", err)
			}
			created = true
		} else {
			return fmt.Errorf("read verification course: %w", err)
		}

		result, err = p.verify(txctx, *courseRecord, languageIDs, structure.ID)
		if err != nil {
			return err
		}
		if created {
			result.Status = "created"
		} else {
			result.Status = "already_present"
		}
		return nil
	})
	if err != nil {
		return Result{}, err
	}
	return result, nil
}

func (p Provisioner) validateDependencies() error {
	d := p.Dependencies
	if d.Tx == nil || d.Courses == nil || d.CourseI18n == nil || d.CourseOutlines == nil || d.ContentAccess == nil || d.CourseReadAccess == nil || d.I18n == nil || d.CodeStructures == nil || d.Modules == nil || d.ModuleI18n == nil || d.CourseModules == nil || d.Sections == nil || d.SectionI18n == nil || d.ModuleSections == nil || d.Lessons == nil || d.LessonI18n == nil || d.SectionLessons == nil || d.Tasks == nil || d.TaskI18n == nil {
		return errors.New("verification fixture dependencies are incomplete")
	}
	return nil
}

func (p Provisioner) ensureEntityIDsAvailable(ctx repository.Context) error {
	d := p.Dependencies
	checks := []struct {
		name string
		id   string
		get  func() error
	}{
		{"course", p.Definition.IDs.Course, func() error { _, err := d.Courses.GetByID(ctx, p.Definition.IDs.Course); return err }},
		{"module", p.Definition.IDs.Module, func() error { _, err := d.Modules.Get(ctx, p.Definition.IDs.Module); return err }},
		{"section", p.Definition.IDs.Section, func() error { _, err := d.Sections.Get(ctx, p.Definition.IDs.Section); return err }},
		{"lesson", p.Definition.IDs.Lesson, func() error { _, err := d.Lessons.Get(ctx, p.Definition.IDs.Lesson); return err }},
		{"task", p.Definition.IDs.Task, func() error { _, err := d.Tasks.Get(ctx, p.Definition.IDs.Task); return err }},
	}
	for _, check := range checks {
		err := check.get()
		if err == nil {
			return drift(check.name+".id", "deterministic id is already owned by another record")
		}
		if !errors.Is(err, domain.ErrNotFound) {
			return fmt.Errorf("check verification %s id: %w", check.name, err)
		}
	}
	return nil
}

func (p Provisioner) createFixture(ctx repository.Context, languageIDs map[string]int, structureID string) error {
	d := p.Dependencies
	f := p.Definition
	guest := domain.LessonReadAccessGuest
	visible := false
	createCourse := course.CreateCourse{Courses: d.Courses, Publisher: discardEvents{}, Tx: d.Tx}
	createdCourse, err := createCourse.Handle(ctx, course.CreateCourseInput{
		ID: f.IDs.Course, Slug: f.Slug,
		CatalogVisible: &visible, LessonReadAccess: &guest,
	})
	if err != nil {
		return fmt.Errorf("create verification course: %w", err)
	}
	for _, language := range f.Languages {
		text := f.Course[language]
		uc := course.UpsertCourseI18n{Courses: d.Courses, CourseI18n: d.CourseI18n, I18n: d.I18n, Tx: d.Tx}
		if _, err := uc.Handle(ctx, course.UpsertCourseI18nInput{CourseID: createdCourse.ID, I18nID: languageIDs[language], Title: text.Title, Description: text.Description}); err != nil {
			return fmt.Errorf("create verification course translation: %w", err)
		}
	}

	moduleStatus := domain.ModuleStatusActive
	visibility := domain.ModuleVisibilityCourseOnly
	createModule := moduleuc.CreateModule{Modules: d.Modules, ModuleI18n: d.ModuleI18n, I18n: d.I18n, Tx: d.Tx}
	createdModule, err := createModule.Handle(ctx, moduleuc.CreateModuleInput{
		ID: f.IDs.Module, Status: &moduleStatus,
		Visibility: &visibility, LessonReadAccess: &guest,
		Translations: moduleTranslations(f, languageIDs),
	})
	if err != nil {
		return fmt.Errorf("create verification module: %w", err)
	}
	addCourseModule := course.AddCourseModule{Courses: d.Courses, Modules: d.Modules, CourseModules: d.CourseModules, Tx: d.Tx}
	if err := addCourseModule.Handle(ctx, course.AddCourseModuleInput{CourseID: createdCourse.ID, ModuleID: createdModule.ID, Order: 1}); err != nil {
		return fmt.Errorf("place verification module: %w", err)
	}

	sectionStatus := domain.SectionStatusActive
	createSection := sectionuc.CreateSection{Sections: d.Sections, SectionI18n: d.SectionI18n, I18n: d.I18n, Tx: d.Tx}
	createdSection, err := createSection.Handle(ctx, sectionuc.CreateSectionInput{
		ID: f.IDs.Section, Status: &sectionStatus,
		LessonReadAccess: &guest, Translations: sectionTranslations(f, languageIDs),
	})
	if err != nil {
		return fmt.Errorf("create verification section: %w", err)
	}
	addModuleSection := moduleuc.AddModuleSection{Modules: d.Modules, Sections: d.Sections, ModuleSections: d.ModuleSections, Tx: d.Tx}
	if err := addModuleSection.Handle(ctx, moduleuc.AddModuleSectionInput{ModuleID: createdModule.ID, SectionID: createdSection.ID, Order: 1}); err != nil {
		return fmt.Errorf("place verification section: %w", err)
	}

	lessonStatus := domain.LessonStatusNoActive
	createLesson := lesson.CreateLesson{Lessons: d.Lessons, LessonI18n: d.LessonI18n, Tasks: d.Tasks, Tx: d.Tx}
	createdLesson, err := createLesson.Handle(ctx, lesson.CreateLessonInput{
		ID: f.IDs.Lesson, Status: &lessonStatus,
		LessonReadAccess: &guest, Translations: lessonTranslations(f, languageIDs),
	})
	if err != nil {
		return fmt.Errorf("create verification lesson: %w", err)
	}
	addSectionLesson := sectionuc.AddSectionLesson{Sections: d.Sections, Lessons: d.Lessons, SectionLessons: d.SectionLessons, Tx: d.Tx}
	if err := addSectionLesson.Handle(ctx, sectionuc.AddSectionLessonInput{SectionID: createdSection.ID, LessonID: createdLesson.ID, Order: 1}); err != nil {
		return fmt.Errorf("place verification lesson: %w", err)
	}

	taskType := f.Task.Type
	executionMode := f.Task.ExecutionMode
	evaluationMode := f.Task.EvaluationMode
	uiMode := f.Task.UIMode
	submissionMode := f.Task.SubmissionMode
	assessmentPurpose := f.Task.AssessmentPurpose
	requiresSandbox := f.Task.RequiresSandbox
	exposesPreview := f.Task.ExposesPreview
	exposesTerminal := f.Task.ExposesTerminal
	supportsLiveValidation := f.Task.SupportsLiveValidation
	createTask := task.CreateTask{
		Tasks: d.Tasks, Lessons: d.Lessons, TaskI18n: d.TaskI18n,
		Publisher: discardEvents{}, StructureRes: d.CodeStructures, Tx: d.Tx,
	}
	if _, err := createTask.Handle(ctx, task.CreateTaskInput{
		ID: f.IDs.Task, LessonID: createdLesson.ID,
		Translations: taskTranslations(f, languageIDs), CodeStructureTypeID: structureID,
		CodeStructure: f.Task.CodeStructure, Type: &taskType, AssessmentPurpose: &assessmentPurpose,
		ExecutionMode: &executionMode, EvaluationMode: &evaluationMode, UIMode: &uiMode,
		SubmissionMode: &submissionMode, RequiresSandbox: &requiresSandbox,
		ExposesPreview: &exposesPreview, ExposesTerminal: &exposesTerminal,
		SupportsLiveValidation: &supportsLiveValidation, Order: 1,
	}); err != nil {
		return fmt.Errorf("create verification lesson task: %w", err)
	}

	updateLesson := lesson.UpdateLesson{Courses: d.Courses, Lessons: d.Lessons, LessonI18n: d.LessonI18n, Tasks: d.Tasks, Tx: d.Tx}
	activeLesson := domain.LessonStatusActive
	if _, err := updateLesson.Handle(ctx, lesson.UpdateLessonInput{
		LessonID: createdLesson.ID, Status: activeLesson, Translations: lessonTranslations(f, languageIDs),
		LessonReadAccess: &guest, LessonReadAccessSet: true,
	}); err != nil {
		return fmt.Errorf("activate verification lesson: %w", err)
	}

	updateCourse := course.UpdateCourse{Courses: d.Courses, Lessons: d.Lessons, Publisher: discardEvents{}, Tx: d.Tx}
	activeCourse := domain.CourseStatusActive
	catalogVisible := true
	if _, err := updateCourse.Handle(ctx, course.UpdateCourseInput{
		CourseID: createdCourse.ID, Status: &activeCourse, CatalogVisible: &catalogVisible,
		LessonReadAccess: &guest, LessonReadAccessSet: true,
	}); err != nil {
		return fmt.Errorf("activate verification course: %w", err)
	}
	return nil
}

func (p Provisioner) verify(ctx repository.Context, courseRecord domain.Course, languageIDs map[string]int, structureID string) (Result, error) {
	d := p.Dependencies
	f := p.Definition
	if courseRecord.ID != f.IDs.Course || courseRecord.Slug != f.Slug || courseRecord.Status != domain.CourseStatusActive || !courseRecord.CatalogVisible || !hasAccess(courseRecord.LessonReadAccess, domain.LessonReadAccessGuest) || courseRecord.MainTechID != nil {
		return Result{}, drift("course", "status, visibility, access, or identity differs from the versioned definition")
	}
	courseTranslations, err := d.CourseI18n.ListByCourse(ctx, courseRecord.ID)
	if err != nil {
		return Result{}, fmt.Errorf("read verification course translations: %w", err)
	}
	if !matchesCourseTranslations(courseTranslations, f, languageIDs) {
		return Result{}, drift("course.translations", "translations differ from the versioned definition")
	}

	modules, err := d.Modules.ListByCourse(ctx, courseRecord.ID)
	if err != nil {
		return Result{}, fmt.Errorf("read verification course modules: %w", err)
	}
	if len(modules) != 1 || modules[0].ID != f.IDs.Module || modules[0].Status != domain.ModuleStatusActive || modules[0].Visibility != domain.ModuleVisibilityCourseOnly || modules[0].TechID != nil || !hasAccess(modules[0].LessonReadAccess, domain.LessonReadAccessGuest) {
		return Result{}, drift("course.modules", "expected exactly one active course-only guest module")
	}
	moduleTranslations, err := d.ModuleI18n.ListByModule(ctx, f.IDs.Module)
	if err != nil {
		return Result{}, fmt.Errorf("read verification module translations: %w", err)
	}
	if !matchesTextTranslations(moduleTranslations, f.Module, languageIDs, func(v domain.ModuleI18n) (string, int, string, string) {
		return v.ModuleID, v.I18nID, v.Title, v.Description
	}, f.IDs.Module) {
		return Result{}, drift("module.translations", "translations differ from the versioned definition")
	}

	sections, err := d.Sections.ListByModule(ctx, f.IDs.Module)
	if err != nil {
		return Result{}, fmt.Errorf("read verification module sections: %w", err)
	}
	if len(sections) != 1 || sections[0].ID != f.IDs.Section || sections[0].Status != domain.SectionStatusActive || sections[0].TechID != nil || !hasAccess(sections[0].LessonReadAccess, domain.LessonReadAccessGuest) {
		return Result{}, drift("module.sections", "expected exactly one active guest section")
	}
	sectionTranslations, err := d.SectionI18n.ListBySection(ctx, f.IDs.Section)
	if err != nil {
		return Result{}, fmt.Errorf("read verification section translations: %w", err)
	}
	if !matchesTextTranslations(sectionTranslations, f.Section, languageIDs, func(v domain.SectionI18n) (string, int, string, string) {
		return v.SectionID, v.I18nID, v.Title, v.Description
	}, f.IDs.Section) {
		return Result{}, drift("section.translations", "translations differ from the versioned definition")
	}

	lessons, err := d.Lessons.ListByCourse(ctx, courseRecord.ID)
	if err != nil {
		return Result{}, fmt.Errorf("read verification course lessons: %w", err)
	}
	lessonEN := f.Lesson["en"]
	if len(lessons) != 1 || lessons[0].ID != f.IDs.Lesson || lessons[0].CourseID != courseRecord.ID || lessons[0].SectionID != f.IDs.Section || lessons[0].Order != 1 || lessons[0].Status != domain.LessonStatusActive || !hasAccess(lessons[0].LessonReadAccess, domain.LessonReadAccessGuest) || lessons[0].Title != lessonEN.Title || lessons[0].Excerpt != lessonEN.Excerpt || lessons[0].Description != lessonEN.Description || lessons[0].ComposeConfigID != nil || len(lessons[0].ComposeConfig) != 0 {
		return Result{}, drift("course.lessons", "expected exactly one active guest lesson in the canonical placement")
	}
	lessonTranslations, err := d.LessonI18n.ListByLesson(ctx, f.IDs.Lesson)
	if err != nil {
		return Result{}, fmt.Errorf("read verification lesson translations: %w", err)
	}
	if !matchesLessonTranslations(lessonTranslations, f, languageIDs) {
		return Result{}, drift("lesson.translations", "translations differ from the versioned definition")
	}

	tasks, err := d.Tasks.ListByLesson(ctx, f.IDs.Lesson)
	if err != nil {
		return Result{}, fmt.Errorf("read verification lesson tasks: %w", err)
	}
	taskType, _ := domain.ParseTaskType(f.Task.Type)
	executionMode, _ := domain.ParseTaskExecutionMode(f.Task.ExecutionMode)
	evaluationMode, _ := domain.ParseTaskEvaluationMode(f.Task.EvaluationMode)
	uiMode, _ := domain.ParseTaskUIMode(f.Task.UIMode)
	submissionMode, _ := domain.ParseTaskSubmissionMode(f.Task.SubmissionMode)
	if len(tasks) != 1 {
		return Result{}, drift("lesson.tasks", "expected exactly one active prerequisite task")
	}
	taskRecord := tasks[0]
	if taskRecord.ID != f.IDs.Task || taskRecord.LessonID != f.IDs.Lesson || taskRecord.Status != domain.TaskStatusActive || taskRecord.Version != 1 || taskRecord.Order != 1 || taskRecord.Type != taskType || taskRecord.AssessmentPurpose != f.Task.AssessmentPurpose || taskRecord.CodeStructureTypeID != structureID || !jsonEqual(taskRecord.CodeStructure, f.Task.CodeStructure) || taskRecord.ExecutionMode != executionMode || taskRecord.EvaluationMode != evaluationMode || taskRecord.UIMode != uiMode || taskRecord.SubmissionMode != submissionMode || taskRecord.RequiresSandbox != f.Task.RequiresSandbox || taskRecord.ExposesPreview != f.Task.ExposesPreview || taskRecord.ExposesTerminal != f.Task.ExposesTerminal || taskRecord.SupportsLiveValidation != f.Task.SupportsLiveValidation || taskRecord.AllowedErrorsCount != 0 || taskRecord.MaxAttempts != nil || taskRecord.DeadlineAt != nil || taskRecord.ComposeConfigID != nil || len(taskRecord.ComposeConfig) != 0 {
		return Result{}, drift("lesson.task", "task differs from the no-run quiz contract")
	}
	taskTranslations, err := d.TaskI18n.ListByTask(ctx, f.IDs.Task)
	if err != nil {
		return Result{}, fmt.Errorf("read verification task translations: %w", err)
	}
	if !matchesTextTranslations(taskTranslations, f.Task.Translations, languageIDs, func(v domain.TaskI18n) (string, int, string, string) {
		return v.TaskID, v.I18nID, v.Title, v.Description
	}, f.IDs.Task) {
		return Result{}, drift("task.translations", "translations differ from the versioned definition")
	}

	outlineUC := course.GetCourseOutline{Outlines: d.CourseOutlines, Access: contentaccess.Service{Repository: d.ContentAccess, ReadAccess: d.CourseReadAccess}}
	outline, err := outlineUC.Handle(ctx, courseRecord.ID, "en")
	if err != nil {
		return Result{}, fmt.Errorf("read public guest course outline: %w", err)
	}
	if outline.Slug != f.Slug || len(outline.Modules) != 1 || outline.Modules[0].ID != f.IDs.Module || len(outline.Modules[0].Sections) != 1 || outline.Modules[0].Sections[0].ID != f.IDs.Section || len(outline.Modules[0].Sections[0].Lessons) != 1 {
		return Result{}, drift("public_outline", "active public hierarchy differs from the versioned fixture")
	}
	outlineLesson := outline.Modules[0].Sections[0].Lessons[0]
	if outlineLesson.ID != f.IDs.Lesson || outlineLesson.TasksCount != 1 || outlineLesson.EffectiveReadAccess != domain.LessonReadAccessGuest || !outlineLesson.CanRead {
		return Result{}, drift("public_outline.lesson", "lesson is not readable by a guest")
	}
	return Result{
		FixtureID: f.FixtureID, FixtureVersion: f.FixtureVersion, CourseID: courseRecord.ID,
		CourseSlug: courseRecord.Slug, CourseActive: true, CatalogVisible: true,
		Modules: 1, Sections: 1, Lessons: 1, GuestReadable: true,
	}, nil
}

func resolveLanguages(ctx repository.Context, repo repository.I18nRepository, languages []string, create bool) (map[string]int, error) {
	ids := make(map[string]int, len(languages))
	for _, language := range languages {
		entry, err := repo.GetByLanguage(ctx, language)
		if errors.Is(err, domain.ErrNotFound) && create {
			if err := repo.Create(ctx, domain.I18n{Language: language}); err != nil {
				return nil, fmt.Errorf("create %s language reference: %w", language, err)
			}
			entry, err = repo.GetByLanguage(ctx, language)
		}
		if err != nil {
			if errors.Is(err, domain.ErrNotFound) {
				return nil, drift("reference.i18n."+language, "required language reference is missing")
			}
			return nil, fmt.Errorf("read %s language reference: %w", language, err)
		}
		if entry.Language != language || entry.ID <= 0 {
			return nil, drift("reference.i18n."+language, "language reference differs from the expected code")
		}
		ids[language] = entry.ID
	}
	return ids, nil
}

func resolveQuizStructure(ctx repository.Context, repo repository.CodeStructureTypeRepository, create bool) (domain.CodeStructureType, error) {
	const (
		id          = "00000000-0000-0000-0000-00000000a900"
		code        = "QUIZ_TEXT_BASIC"
		name        = "Quiz text answer"
		description = "Текстовый ответ без sandbox, проверяется встроенной exact-match логикой."
		validator   = "internal-quiz-validator"
	)
	structure, err := repo.GetByCode(ctx, code)
	if errors.Is(err, domain.ErrNotFound) && create {
		if _, idErr := repo.GetByID(ctx, id); idErr == nil {
			return domain.CodeStructureType{}, drift("reference.code_structure_type."+code, "canonical reference id is occupied")
		} else if !errors.Is(idErr, domain.ErrNotFound) {
			return domain.CodeStructureType{}, fmt.Errorf("check quiz structure reference id: %w", idErr)
		}
		descriptionValue, validatorValue := description, validator
		created := domain.CodeStructureType{
			ID: id, Code: code, Name: name, Description: &descriptionValue,
			ValidatorService: &validatorValue, CreatedAt: time.Date(2026, time.March, 11, 0, 0, 0, 0, time.UTC),
		}
		if err := repo.Create(ctx, created); err != nil {
			return domain.CodeStructureType{}, fmt.Errorf("create quiz structure reference: %w", err)
		}
		structure, err = repo.GetByCode(ctx, code)
	}
	if err != nil {
		if errors.Is(err, domain.ErrNotFound) {
			return domain.CodeStructureType{}, drift("reference.code_structure_type."+code, "required quiz structure reference is missing")
		}
		return domain.CodeStructureType{}, fmt.Errorf("read quiz structure reference: %w", err)
	}
	if structure.Code != code || structure.Name != name || !sameOptionalString(structure.Description, description) || !sameOptionalString(structure.ValidatorService, validator) {
		return domain.CodeStructureType{}, drift("reference.code_structure_type."+code, "reference semantics differ from the Course-owned contract")
	}
	return *structure, nil
}

func moduleTranslations(f Definition, ids map[string]int) []domain.ModuleI18n {
	result := make([]domain.ModuleI18n, 0, len(f.Languages))
	for _, lang := range f.Languages {
		text := f.Module[lang]
		result = append(result, domain.ModuleI18n{I18nID: ids[lang], Language: lang, Title: text.Title, Description: text.Description})
	}
	return result
}

func sectionTranslations(f Definition, ids map[string]int) []domain.SectionI18n {
	result := make([]domain.SectionI18n, 0, len(f.Languages))
	for _, lang := range f.Languages {
		text := f.Section[lang]
		result = append(result, domain.SectionI18n{I18nID: ids[lang], Language: lang, Title: text.Title, Description: text.Description})
	}
	return result
}

func lessonTranslations(f Definition, ids map[string]int) []domain.LessonI18n {
	result := make([]domain.LessonI18n, 0, len(f.Languages))
	for _, lang := range f.Languages {
		text := f.Lesson[lang]
		result = append(result, domain.LessonI18n{I18nID: ids[lang], Language: lang, Title: text.Title, Excerpt: text.Excerpt, Description: text.Description})
	}
	return result
}

func taskTranslations(f Definition, ids map[string]int) []domain.TaskI18n {
	result := make([]domain.TaskI18n, 0, len(f.Languages))
	for _, lang := range f.Languages {
		text := f.Task.Translations[lang]
		result = append(result, domain.TaskI18n{I18nID: ids[lang], Language: lang, Title: text.Title, Description: text.Description})
	}
	return result
}

func matchesCourseTranslations(actual []domain.CourseI18n, f Definition, ids map[string]int) bool {
	if len(actual) != len(f.Languages) {
		return false
	}
	seen := map[int]bool{}
	for _, entry := range actual {
		if seen[entry.I18nID] {
			return false
		}
		seen[entry.I18nID] = true
		matched := false
		for _, language := range f.Languages {
			want := f.Course[language]
			if entry.I18nID == ids[language] && entry.Title == want.Title && entry.Description == want.Description {
				matched = true
				break
			}
		}
		if !matched {
			return false
		}
	}
	return true
}

func matchesTextTranslations[T any](actual []T, expected map[string]Text, ids map[string]int, fields func(T) (string, int, string, string), entityID string) bool {
	if len(actual) != len(expected) {
		return false
	}
	seen := map[int]bool{}
	for _, entry := range actual {
		id, i18nID, title, description := fields(entry)
		if id != entityID || seen[i18nID] {
			return false
		}
		seen[i18nID] = true
		matched := false
		for language, want := range expected {
			if i18nID == ids[language] && title == want.Title && description == want.Description {
				matched = true
				break
			}
		}
		if !matched {
			return false
		}
	}
	return true
}

func matchesLessonTranslations(actual []domain.LessonI18n, f Definition, ids map[string]int) bool {
	if len(actual) != len(f.Languages) {
		return false
	}
	seen := map[int]bool{}
	for _, entry := range actual {
		if entry.LessonID != f.IDs.Lesson || seen[entry.I18nID] {
			return false
		}
		seen[entry.I18nID] = true
		matched := false
		for _, language := range f.Languages {
			want := f.Lesson[language]
			if entry.I18nID == ids[language] && entry.Title == want.Title && entry.Excerpt == want.Excerpt && entry.Description == want.Description {
				matched = true
				break
			}
		}
		if !matched {
			return false
		}
	}
	return true
}

func hasAccess(actual *domain.LessonReadAccess, expected domain.LessonReadAccess) bool {
	return actual != nil && *actual == expected
}

func jsonEqual(left, right []byte) bool {
	var leftValue, rightValue any
	return json.Unmarshal(left, &leftValue) == nil && json.Unmarshal(right, &rightValue) == nil && reflect.DeepEqual(leftValue, rightValue)
}

func sameOptionalString(actual *string, expected string) bool {
	return actual != nil && *actual == expected
}

func drift(path, reason string) error {
	return fmt.Errorf("%w at %s: %s", ErrDrift, path, reason)
}

type discardEvents struct{}

func (discardEvents) Publish(context.Context, string, any) error { return nil }
